home.subtitle: Freelance web developer in Grenoble. I build your custom website, from the first call to launch. A showcase site goes live in 2 weeks, from €1,400.

about.title: One
about.description: I'm Téo, a freelance web developer in Grenoble. For 4 years I've been building websites and tools for independents, small businesses and research labs. You talk directly to the person building your site: no agency, no subcontracting. I deliver a fast, clean site that you can keep growing, with or without me. Alongside that, I'm finishing a computer science engineering degree at IMT Nord Europe.
about.quote: I reply within 24 hours, and it's always me who picks up.

process.description: From your first message to launch.

steps.title: We talk
steps.text: You tell me about your business and what you expect from the site.

steps.title: I send you a quote
steps.text: Each item broken down, with the final price. Take your time to think it over.

steps.title: I build the site
steps.text: You approve the mockup first. During development, you follow progress on a test link.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: I put the site live and show you how to edit your content. I'm still reachable if you need me.

faq.description: The questions I get asked most. Yours isn't here?

items.q: How much does a website cost?
items.a: A showcase site starts at €1,400, a site with features at €2,900. The exact price depends on your project and is in the quote, free and sent within 24 hours. Some plans can also be paid monthly.
Allow 1 to 2 weeks for a showcase site, 2 to 5 weeks for a site with features and 4 to 8 weeks for a complete project. The schedule is set in the quote.
Yes. The site, its code, your content and the domain name are in your name. With a one-time payment, as soon as it's paid off. With a subscription, at the end of the commitment.

items.q: Can I edit the site myself?
items.a: Yes, if you'd like: I can add an admin area to change your text, photos or prices without touching code. Otherwise, I'll handle it for you.
Support is included for 30 days (60 for a complete site). After that, monthly maintenance covers hosting, updates, backups and small changes.

items.q: Will my site show up on Google?
items.a: SEO basics are included: a fast, mobile-friendly site, well-structured tags and content, and Google Search Console setup. Nobody can guarantee first place, but your site starts on solid ground.

items.q: I don't have a logo or copy. Is that a problem?
items.a: No. I help you structure your pages and write your text. For branding, the Custom Design plan creates a mockup that fits your business before development.
Yes, around Grenoble. Anywhere else in France, video calls work just as well.
